title: Login rate limiter: Basic header spellings, multi-line X-Forwarded-For, shared client-IP resolver for the audit log, pair-only success clearing, injected clock

criteria.given: LoginRateLimitFilter reads an Authorization header the way Spring's BasicAuthenticationConverter does (trim, case-insensitive Basic prefix, skip six characters)
criteria.then: no spelling the converter accepts escapes the per-user budgets, and Basic credentials with no attributable username get the strict per-address rule

criteria.given: X-Forwarded-For arrives as several header lines
criteria.then: all lines are read with getHeaders, joined in order, and the n-th entry from the right is the client
both resolve the client address through one shared resolver that honours saiku.auth.trustedProxyHops
only the (IP, username) bucket is cleared, never the per-username bucket
time comes from an injected ticker, not Thread.sleep
documents that trustedProxyHops counts the immediate proxy, that setting it too high hands the key to the caller, and what a success clears
